verdict.text: The change does what the plan asks.
`_cause` keeps git's `fatal:` and `error:` lines in order, adds claude's last line when it is not already the last kept line, joins them with "; " and caps the result at 400 characters.
`_require` still names the command and ends with the fix line, and `_MISMATCH` still reads claude's full output.
Each eval row's test fails when its behavior breaks; I checked this by changing the code in a scratch copy.
Gates: `loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree printed "stamp green: 3fe3de39db7fb93fdd4ad4c68f421943bebc28d4f0290e9521c083b094b16e4b".
lint, format, tests, integration and rows r1 to r4 all passed.
Code read: `_cause` and `_require` in src/kmctl/plugin.py and every caller (`_json`, `install`).
The mismatch check at plugin.py:280 runs before `_require` and still reads `added.stdout + added.stderr`.
The `kept[-1:]` test stops a last line that is itself `fatal:` from showing up twice.
The cap gives at most 399 characters plus "…", which is 400.
Empty or blank output still gives "no output", as before.
r1 and r2, mutation: in a scratch copy I put back the old last-line-only behavior.
test_cause_named_on_ssh_fallback, test_cause_keeps_error_lines, test_last_line_and_cap_long_stderr and test_ssh_fallback_retried failed.
The single-line and no-output tests passed, as they should, since that behavior did not change.
With the cap removed and nothing else changed, only test_last_line_and_cap_long_stderr failed.
The single-line test compares the whole message against today's exact text, so it covers r2's "differs from today's" and the command and fix wording.
r3: test_ssh_fallback_retried builds a real kmctl message from the SSH-fallback stub.
It runs it through the repo's own conftest retry hook in an integration-marked pytester test that fails twice and then passes, and it asserts passed=1 and three runs.
With the old message the hook did not retry and the test failed, so the row checks the real path.
r4: the stamp's r4 run (`-m "not integration or integration"`) passed.
Consistency: the conftest comment above NETWORK_ERRORS now matches what kmctl passes on.
The `_cause` docstring matches the code.
No page in docs/, README.md or .okf/ describes the error text.
None.
`_cause` strips each line, so a last line with leading indentation loses that indentation where the old code kept it.
This does not matter in practice.
The diff against main also shows .loop/ files.
That is only because main moved after the branch was cut.
The worktree's own changes are plugin.py, conftest.py and tests/test_plugin_error.py.
